The one workflow, nightly.yml, runs scripts/validate --full per area on a schedule and on a manual dispatch, and reports only. Do not add a push, pull_request or merge_group trigger, a required check or a merge gate unless the owner asks, and do not copy a check into a workflow: scripts/validate owns every check, with affected rows selected by the diff.
